beat: Further teasing, departure and the lace-bra suggestion

lines.original: Dhika: so.... all your gfs look like this... she teased him and protruded her body...
lines.local: Dhika Bantu ko tease karne ke liye apna body aage karke: Toh tumhari saari girlfriends bhi aisi dikhti hain?

lines.original: Bantu: hehe... I cannot say without looking at it naked.....
lines.local: Bantu: Hehe, bina naked dekhe kaise bata sakta hoon?

lines.original: Dhika: aiii.....I meant pretty like you call me......
lines.local: Dhika: Aiii, mera matlab meri tarah pretty hain ya nahi!

lines.original: Giving an angry look at him..... she hit him on his Chest.... then slowly grazed it a couple of times.... on the third time...she let her hand wander on his Chest a few seconds.... and then jerked it back to her...
lines.local: Dhika ne use angry look dekar chest par maara, phir do-ek baar dheere se graze kiya. Teesri baar uska haath kuch seconds Bantu ki chest par thehra, phir usne jhat se haath hata liya.

lines.original: Dhika: feeling so blushed on what she did.... she came back to senses.... okay dear, enough ogling at me.... leave now... I will see you on Wednesday.....
lines.local: Dhika apne action par bahut blush karke hosh mein aayi: Okay dear, ab mujhe ogle karna band karo aur jao; Wednesday ko milte hain.

lines.original: With a heavy heart...he stood up and wore his T shirt and proceeded to the door.... but stood a moment and turned back to her....
lines.local: Bantu bhaari mann se khada hua, T-shirt pehni aur darwaaze ki taraf gaya, par ek pal rukkar wapas muda.

lines.original: Bantu: miss.... you should wear a lace bra....
lines.local: Bantu: Miss, aapko lace bra pehenni chahiye.

lines.original: Dhika: why is that ? she saw him curiously...

She has a few of them which John had brought her, but she has never worn any of them.... they are still in package, in her wardrobe ... and she had no idea what a lace bra is... as she has not seen them yet..
lines.local: John ne uske liye kuch lace bras khareedi thi, par unhone ab tak packages se nikal kar nahi pehni thi; wardrobe mein hi thi. Usne lace bra dekhi bhi nahi thi, isliye usse pata nahi tha ki woh kaisi hoti hai.

lines.original: Bantu: hehe...my gfs say it feels nice against the skin... he scratched his head....
lines.local: Bantu sir khujaate hue: Hehe, meri girlfriends kehti hain skin ke against bahut acchi lagti hai.

lines.original: Dhika: smiling...hmmmmm!.. okay dear, I will try it some day....
lines.local: Dhika muskuraakar: Hmm! Theek dear, kabhi try karungi.

lines.original: Bantu hoped that someday should come soon.... and left......
lines.local: Bantu ko ummeed thi ki woh 'kabhi' jaldi aaye; phir woh chala gaya.
